# Harbor Traders — learning fixture

This is a fictional board game, created for Jarvis retrieval tests. These are not rules for a commercial game.

## Setup

Each player starts with seven copper coins and two wooden boats. Place the lighthouse in the center of the table.

## Trading

On your turn, trade three copper coins for one spice crate. You may trade only once per turn.

## Scoring

Each spice crate scores four victory points. The lighthouse scores nine victory points for its owner.
